description: Move money between your workspace and a child workspace, in USD cents: direction to_workspace (default) funds the child from your balance, to_parent takes some of its balance back. Refused when the payer's effective balance cannot cover it (insufficient_balance) or it would pass the child's monthly limit (transfer_limit_reached).

amountCents.description: How much to move, in USD cents (1 to 500000).

direction.description: to_workspace: from the parent into the child workspace. to_parent: from the child back to the parent.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

note.description: Free text kept on both ledger rows, up to 200 characters.

name: transfer_credit
title: Transfer credit
